lens: clarity & depth: would a curious 15-year-old follow it and an expert respect it; AlexNet and transformer step by step in sync; each era's belief, dissent, duration

A later revision overwrote the fix, and the shot is still marked 'revised'); T212 ch09-s05 (no Marcus 2018 card for the third round running; Marcus does appear in ch11-s08 with his 2022 words, so this drops to minor).
summary: This is the round where both deep dives finally land with their pictures. The transformer's central image now works. On 'every' (4.79) the whole hall lights. By 'every other' the threads join every pair, down to the vanishing point, and 'all at once' is the brightness peak. A 15-year-old now sees the idea as they hear it. The backprop plate that both dives lean on is pushed in, with a readable blame formula and visible tugs. The silent beat after it now carries the 1986 Nature quote. Classical ML is now two clean steps: hand-chosen features, then the kernel lift with the glass cut held for about 4 s. Softmax is voiced. The era structure meets the brief end to end. Every candle has a belief, a named rim and a duration. The knowledge era gains Hubert Dreyfus, staged with the rule slips flying up and then collapsing on 'sudden unexpected difficulties'. The rest are: the logic machine (Gerard, 16 years), the learning machine (Minsky, ~7), sterile many layers (Hinton, 17), knowledge (Dreyfus and the 1984 panel, ~7), fiddly nets (the three holdouts, 10-15), hand-cut features (13), warm-up (guttered, date unknown), deep learning works on everything (Goodfellow-style adversarials, Buolamwini and Gebru, still burning), read in order (Uszkoreit, 2 decades), scale (octopus, parrots, Marcus), worry (three camps), one to three years behind (~2), and months not years. Every AlexNet and attention number I re-checked is right: the stencil sums -4 and 3.88, 2/0/4/2 halved to 1/0/2/1, and the softmax 0.20/0.07/0.53/0.20. What keeps clarity from 8.5 is three small text cards that the narration never explains and that have been routed for two or three rounds. In ch08-s05 the fix was made and then overwritten. In ch10-s12 BLEU came back. In ch09-s05 nothing changed. The fix stage also wrote no per-shot ledger, so 'fixed' cannot be audited.

issues.problem: The round-2 verdict required a per-shot outcome ledger, and round2-global claims film-shots now writes one ('film-shots writes a per-shot ledger to film.json stages.fixes[round<n>-shots]'). film.json stages.fixes holds only round1-global and round2-global. No round2-shots entry exists, so no shot outcome can be audited. Worse, at least one fix was silently lost. qa/legibility/ch08-s05.json (05:11Z) measured the new '→ 2 great halls of 4,096 / → 1,000 answers' card, but the source file saved at 05:32Z still has L1 = ['55 · 27 · 13 · 13 · 13', '→ 4096 · 4096 · 1000'], and that is the version that rendered. A later revision pass overwrote it, and stages.shots still says 'revised'.
issues.fix: Make film-loop pass ledger: 'round3-shots' to film-shots and fail the stage if the key is missing at the end. Before an author writes a shot file, check that its mtime matches the one read at task start; otherwise re-read and merge, so concurrent or resumed passes cannot revert each other. After the shots stage, diff each routed note's key strings (e.g. '2 great halls', 'Marcus', '1/7') against the source, and mark 'skipped' in the ledger when they are absent.

issues.problem: This is a regression of round-2 T208. The rendered card from 'halls' (11.7 s) to the end still reads '55 · 27 · 13 · 13 · 13 → 4096 · 4096 · 1000'. These are spatial sizes no viewer can decode and the narration never mentions, and they sit beside the '≈60 million numbers / 650,000 neurons' card the line does support. The file's own header comment already describes the intended card.
issues.fix: Set L1 to ['5 stencil layers', '→ 2 great halls of 4,096', '→ 1,000 answers'] (line 113), inked on 'halls' (11.73), with '→ 1,000 answers' brightening on 'thousand' (15.70). Keep the 60M/650k card. Re-sheet, then re-run legibility (it already passed this text at 23.6 px).

issues.problem: This is round-2 T207, unapplied for the third round, and now worse. In the 3.4 s silence between L1025 and L1027 (9.6-13.5), the sundial card shows '12 hours · one machine, 8 GPUs'. Beside it sit a two-bar chart 'GNMT+RL · Transformer', the text '≈ 1/7 the compute of GNMT+RL (derived)', and a returned 'EN→DE 27.3 · 28.4 BLEU' line, all small. None is spoken. BLEU is a term the film never defines.
issues.fix: Keep one card: sundial + '12 hours · one machine, 8 GPUs', at 22 px cap or larger, from 'sundial' (9.66) to 'wall' (13.54). Delete the BLEU line and the 1/7 bar chart. 'out-translated every rival after half a day' in L1024 already carries the result.

issues.problem: This is round-2 T212, unapplied for the third round. The deep-learning creed's rim names adversarial examples and Buolamwini/Gebru, but not the 2018 'it will hit a wall' critique. The silent tail (21.0-24.9) is spent pinning an unreadable slip. Marcus appears only in 2022 (ch11-s08), so the generalisation and reasoning dissent the bible lists for this era (e9-marcus) is missing here.
issues.fix: In 21.0-24.9 pin a horizontal card at 22 px cap or larger: 'Gary Marcus, 2018: Deep Learning: A Critical Appraisal' [e9-marcus], held at least 2 s. Alternatively, if ch09-s05 cannot change, add '(critic since 2018: A Critical Appraisal)' under Marcus's name in ch11-s08.

issues.problem: Dreyfus is in, and the rule slips that rise and then tumble on 'sudden unexpected difficulties' (28.4-30.4) are a lovely gloss. But his name card arrives at about 20.5, after 'Hubert Dreyfus' (19.34-19.84). It is a small 'HUBERT DREYFUS / philosopher' at the right edge, with no book or year. The verbatim quotation has no quote card, so viewers cannot tell it is his words rather than the narrator's.
issues.fix: Ink the name card on 'Hubert' (19.34) at 22 px cap or larger: 'HUBERT DREYFUS · What Computers Can't Do, 1972'. On 'early' (26.19), set a quote card with the verbatim '…early, dramatic success followed by sudden unexpected difficulties.' (q-dreyfus-pattern) above the tumbling slips, held to the cut.

issues.problem: Round-2 T205 is now mostly done: the fog plate holds and a stencil-mosaic tower stands in the fog by 27.7. On 'the net cut its own' (25.82-26.25), though, the sheet still shows only drifting specks, and the mosaic assembles on 'deep' (27.6). So 'cut its own' and 'many layers deep' share one image, and the first has none.
issues.fix: On 'cut' (25.82), let the specks snap into the first stencil row (the learned edge mosaic from ch08-s06), about a quarter of the frame. On 'many layers' (26.88), stack the tower over it, so it is complete by 'deep learning' (28.4).

issues.problem: The all-pairs web is now right. The dark beat, though, still runs from 'keep' (3.34) to 'every' (4.79), about 1.45 s, so the word 'attention' (3.78), the thing being kept, is spoken over a near-black hall with only the abandoned lamp lit.
issues.fix: Shorten the dip to 0.5 s or less so it ends by 'attention' (3.78). Let the slips glow faintly on 'attention', then step to full on 'every' (4.79) as now.

issues.problem: From 18.6 to 20.5 a blank grey card sits at the right of the loom before the blame formula inks into it at about 22.5. To a viewer it reads as an empty placeholder during 'back-propagation, runs back down'.
issues.fix: Bring the card in already inked, on 'lantern by lantern' (20.37), or crossfade its text in with the card. No blank card stock.

issues.problem: L1110 opens on 'AlexNet's waiting note came back' (about 1.5-2.5 s), but the 2012 '…simply by waiting for faster GPUs and bigger datasets…' card appears only in the music-only tail (21.2-22.75), about 20 s after it is named. The callback lands on the ear but not the eye.
issues.fix: Glint the waiting-note card on the board on 'waiting note' (about 1.6-2.6 s), before the log-scale chart takes the frame. Keep the tail glint as a bookend, or cut the tail by 1.5 s.

issues.problem: This is the leftover half of round-2 T210. The film says 'predict the next word', and an expert will note that GPT-2 predicts tokens, not words. The TOKENS label is not voiced.
issues.fix: Change it to '…with one goal: “predict the next word”, or rather, the next word-piece. No labels needed…' Keep the quoted span verbatim and outside the gloss, and re-narrate solo. ch11-s02 absorbs about 1.3 s.

issues.problem: The kernel hill rises about 1.4 s after 'lifted' (9.07): it is flat at 9.04 and up by 10.5. The 'features, chosen by hand' label is visible only from 2.8 to 3.7 and from 16.2 onward, not while 'An expert chose what to measure' (1.0-2.8) is spoken.
issues.fix: Start the hill on 'lifted' (9.07) and reach full height by 'hill' (10.29). Ink the 'features, chosen by hand' label on 'measure' (2.15) and hold it through 'drew the line' (4.99).

best_moments: ch10-s04 (fixed after two rounds): on 'every' all the slips down the hall light together, and by 'every other' threads hang between every pair down to the vanishing point, peaking on 'all at once'. Self-attention as a picture a teenager will remember.

ch10-s06: an attention computation you can check by hand. label × question → 0·2·0·0 etc., scores 2/0/4/2, ÷√4 → 1/0/2/1, the SOFTMAX jug pours 0.20/0.07/0.53/0.20 (correct), and 'bank now means: water 0.53'. 'Softmax, to the trade' is now voiced on its label.

ch08-s04: the pierced-tin stencil as a real edge kernel. The worked sum gives -4, which the RELU card clips to 0. The next position gives max(0, …) = 3.88, then sliding it everywhere lights the 4's outline on 'convolution'.

ch05-s04 (fixed): the pushed-in lantern loom with a legible blame formula (blame(i) = slope(i)·Σ blame(j)·w; Δw = -ε·blame·y), the +/- tugs, epochs ticking to the solved XOR, then the Nature 1986 quote and 'MANY-LAYERED NETS ARE A STERILE EXTENSION' scored 1969-1986, 17 years.

ch06-s03b (new split): 'features, chosen by hand' on the readout, the machine drawing only the line, then the inner/outer crowds that no straight line separates, lifted into a cone and parted by a glass plane. The SVM era's strength and its blind spot in 15 s.
ch05-s07: Hubert Dreyfus at the knowledge candle's rim, while the IF…THEN slips rise and then cascade down on 'sudden unexpected difficulties'. A named dissenter and a visual argument.

ch15-s08 (fixed): the recap pushes onto RULES, KNOWLEDGE, LEARNING and DATA/FIRE on their words, then pulls back for 'the board was a network all along'. The dark lantern is now shared, 'THE FIELD, 2019-2025: Anthropic 2025 · Jain & Wallace 2019'.

ch11-s05: the log-log scaling line ruled across the board, a skyline growing to the 175-billion tower, then few-shot as 'hot → cold, up → down, big → small, fast → ?'. Then the candle, 'SCALE IS THE MAIN LEVER · contested, as of October 2026'.

ch14-s04b (fixed): the three export-control positions as large horizontal tags, lit one by one (Huang, China's MFA, then Amodei/Khan), beside 'CHINA IS ONE TO THREE YEARS BEHIND · lit Oct 2022 · out Jan 2025 · ≈2 years'.
